shelters.name: Animal Refuge League of Greater Portland
shelters.description: Animal Refuge League of Greater Portland is a nonprofit animal welfare organization providing shelter, care, and adoption services for homeless animals in southern Maine since 1911.

shelters.name: Bangor Humane Society
shelters.description: Bangor Humane Society is a private, nonprofit organization dedicated to providing quality care and shelter for homeless pets in the greater Bangor region since 1869.

shelters.name: Kennebec Valley Humane Society
shelters.description: Kennebec Valley Humane Society provides compassionate care and adoption services for homeless cats and dogs in central Maine.

shelters.name: Greater Androscoggin Humane Society
shelters.description: Greater Androscoggin Humane Society is the only open-admission shelter in Androscoggin County, providing shelter and adoption services for companion animals.

shelters.name: Midcoast Humane
shelters.description: Midcoast Humane provides shelter, care, and adoption services for homeless animals in Sagadahoc, Lincoln, and surrounding counties in coastal Maine.

shelters.name: SPCA of Hancock County
shelters.description: SPCA of Hancock County is a nonprofit shelter providing care and adoption services for homeless animals in the Bar Harbor and Ellsworth areas.

shelters.name: Franklin County Animal Shelter
shelters.description: Franklin County Animal Shelter is a nonprofit municipal shelter serving Franklin County communities with animal shelter and adoption services.

shelters.name: HART (Homeless Animal Rescue Team) of Maine
shelters.description: HART of Maine is a nonprofit rescue organization dedicated to rescuing homeless cats and dogs and finding them loving forever homes.

shelters.name: Coastal Humane Society
shelters.description: Now part of Midcoast Humane, Coastal Humane Society continues its mission to provide shelter and care for homeless animals in the midcoast region.

shelters.name: P.A.W.S. Animal Adoption Center
shelters.description: P.A.W.S. Animal Adoption Center is a nonprofit, no-kill shelter serving Knox County and surrounding areas with adoption services for cats and dogs.

shelters.name: Responsible Pet Care of Oxford Hills
shelters.description: Responsible Pet Care of Oxford Hills is a nonprofit shelter providing animal welfare services including adoption, spay/neuter programs, and community education.

shelters.name: Ark Animal Shelter
shelters.description: Ark Animal Shelter is a nonprofit shelter serving Washington County, providing care and adoption services for homeless cats and dogs in eastern Maine.

shelters.name: Underhound Railroad
shelters.description: Underhound Railroad is a nonprofit rescue organization transporting homeless dogs from high-kill shelters in the South to loving homes in Maine and New England.

shelters.name: Sato Heart Rescue
shelters.description: Sato Heart Rescue is a nonprofit organization rescuing abandoned satos (street dogs) from Puerto Rico and finding them forever homes in Maine.

shelters.name: Central Aroostook Humane Society
shelters.description: Central Aroostook Humane Society provides shelter and adoption services for homeless animals in northern Maine's Aroostook County region.

shelters.name: Harvest Hills Animal Shelter
shelters.description: Harvest Hills Animal Shelter is a nonprofit organization providing temporary shelter and adoption services for homeless cats and dogs in central Maine.

shelters.name: Passion for Paws
shelters.description: Passion for Paws is a foster-based nonprofit rescue organization dedicated to saving homeless dogs and cats in Maine and finding them loving homes.

shelters.name: Almost Home Cat Rescue
shelters.description: Almost Home Cat Rescue is a volunteer-run, foster-based nonprofit organization dedicated to rescuing and rehoming homeless cats in southern Maine.

shelters.name: Maine Cat Rescue
shelters.description: Maine Cat Rescue is a nonprofit, foster-based rescue organization dedicated to saving homeless, abandoned, and feral cats throughout Maine.

shelters.name: Downeast Humane Society
shelters.description: Downeast Humane Society serves the Ellsworth and Hancock County area with animal welfare services including adoption and community programs.

shelters.name: Waldo County Pet Food Pantry and Humane Society
shelters.description: Waldo County Pet Food Pantry and Humane Society provides food assistance to pet owners in need and helps homeless animals find forever homes.

shelters.name: Lucky Pup Rescue
shelters.description: Lucky Pup Rescue is a nonprofit rescue organization saving dogs from high-kill shelters and transporting them to loving homes in Maine and New England.

shelters.name: New England Lab Rescue
shelters.description: New England Lab Rescue is a nonprofit organization dedicated to rescuing and rehoming Labrador Retrievers and Lab mixes throughout New England including Maine.

shelters.name: Casco Bay Pibble Rescue
shelters.description: Casco Bay Pibble Rescue is a nonprofit organization dedicated to rescuing, rehabilitating, and rehoming pit bulls and bully breeds in Maine.

shelters.name: Maine Greyhound Placement Service
shelters.description: Maine Greyhound Placement Service is a nonprofit organization dedicated to finding loving homes for retired racing greyhounds in Maine and New England.

shelters.name: Town of Sanford Animal Control
shelters.description: Town of Sanford Animal Control provides municipal animal control services including stray animal intake, lost and found pets, and adoption services.

shelters.name: City of Portland Animal Refuge League
shelters.description: Portland Animal Control provides municipal animal services for the City of Portland, working with local rescues to help homeless animals find homes.

shelters.name: Hearts & Tails Animal Alliance
shelters.description: Hearts & Tails Animal Alliance is a nonprofit, foster-based rescue organization dedicated to saving homeless pets in Maine and placing them in loving homes.

shelters.name: Pixie Project Maine
shelters.description: Pixie Project Maine is a nonprofit rescue organization focused on finding homes for special needs and overlooked animals in Maine.

shelters.name: Safe Haven Humane Society
shelters.description: Safe Haven Humane Society is a nonprofit, no-kill shelter providing care and adoption services for homeless cats and dogs in southern Maine.

notes: Comprehensive collection of Maine animal shelters, humane societies, SPCAs, and rescue organizations. Includes both municipal shelters and nonprofit rescue organizations across the state from Portland to Aroostook County. Some foster-based rescues may not have physical addresses listed.
